vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are raised regardless of the major-suppression rule below (Dependabot parity).

packageRules.description: Suppress major bumps — human-triaged (API breaks, BOM coherence, Vue 3->4, etc.). Mirrors dependabot.yml's `ignore: version-update:semver-major`. Security advisories override this via vulnerabilityAlerts.
Auto-merge patch / pin / digest once the pipeline is green. Mirrors dependabot-automerge.yml (patches-only).
Backend catch-all (UnboundID, Jakarta, Lombok, Flyway, PG JDBC, Jackson, ...). Renovate is last-match-wins, so this is listed BEFORE the specific groups, which override it.
Backend: Spring Boot / Framework / Security / Data move together under the BOM — one PR per Spring patch wave.
Backend test tooling (mockito, archunit, junit, testcontainers, bytebuddy) — one PR per wave.
Frontend catch-all (axios, tailwindcss, typescript, eslint, @types/*, ...). Listed before the specific npm groups (last-match-wins).
Frontend: Vue + Pinia + Vite patch together.
Base images (Dockerfiles + compose) bump in lockstep to keep dev/CI from drifting. Mirrors dependabot.yml's docker `docker-images` group.
GitLab CI image/service tags — the GitLab analogue of dependabot.yml's github-actions ecosystem.
